acp_jobs.name: landing_page
acp_jobs.title: Landing Page
acp_jobs.description: Full landing page build and deployment for your product. Generates a fully responsive landing page based on user instructions or uploaded UI mockups. No credentials required.

acp_jobs.name: full_stack_app
acp_jobs.title: Full Stack App
acp_jobs.description: Full stack application with API and frontend. Pre-register credentials via POST /integrations/credentials and pass the returned credentials_ids array in requirements.

acp_jobs.name: api_integration
acp_jobs.title: API Integration
acp_jobs.description: Add third-party API integrations (Stripe, Supabase, Resend, etc.) to an existing project.

acp_jobs.name: iteration
acp_jobs.title: Iteration
acp_jobs.description: Edit or refine an existing project's landing page, app, or integration based on written instructions and an optional reference image. Requires the project's ID and pre-registered credentials.
